definition.name: compressed-product-display
definition.definition: Byte-matched (tex:1077-1083, compr_prod): X\cdot Y = Co_{P,R}(XY): S_{P,Q} x S_{Q,R} -> S_{P,R}; ||X\cdot Y - XY|| <= O(delta+eps)||X|| ||Y||; for nonvanishing P the compressed product makes S_P an O(delta+eps)-C*-algebra with unit wtP=Co_P(P).
